newsitem.title: USA: Skyline says mulling Meritage bid.
newsitem.headline: Skyline says mulling Meritage bid.

text.p: Skyline Chili Inc said in a statement on Tuesday that it had received a bid from Meritage Hospitality Group Inc for Skyline and had set up a committee advised by Equitable Securities Corp to evaluate the offer, among other alternatives.

"The committee and Equitable are conducting a systematic evaluation of potential strategic alternatives and financing opportunities available to the company, including Meritage's offer," said Joseph Madigan, chairman of the committee.
Meritage said earlier that it had made a merger offer to the restaurant chain which valued the company at $34 million. ((--New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
